description: The agent must: (1) Read /workspace/fetch_tasks.json to discover the 3 URLs and their target filenames. (2) Consult SKILL.md to learn the strict 4-step priority fallback chain: markdown.new → defuddle.md → r.jina.ai → Scrapling. (3) For each URL, attempt the services in the EXACT order defined by SKILL.md — starting with markdown.new, then defuddle.md, then r.jina.ai. (4) Route requests through the mock server per /workspace/SERVICE_ENDPOINTS.txt. (5) The proprietary trap: markdown.new returns 503 for all URLs; defuddle.md returns 200 only for the CRISPR URL (crispr_advances_2024.md), and 4xx/5xx for the other two — so r.jina.ai must be used for neural_plasticity_2024.md and quantum_entanglement_review.md. An agent skipping directly to r.jina.ai without trying markdown.new and defuddle.md first will fail the priority order check. An agent that calls r.jina.ai for the CRISPR URL even after defuddle.md succeeded will fail the 'no unnecessary call' check. (6) Save each result as the exact filename specified in the task file with the Markdown content obtained from whichever service succeeded.
